newsitem.title: USA: Pall reaches sales agreement with Matheson.
newsitem.headline: Pall reaches sales agreement with Matheson.

text.p: Pall Corp said it signed a sales and distribution agreement with Matheson Electronic Products Group, a subsidiary of Nippon Sanso Corp.

Under the terms of the agreement, Pall's Microelectronics Division has the right to sell and distribute the NANOCHEM point-of-use gas purification products for use in semiconductor manufacturing, a news release issued by Pall said.
Pall said it will also sell and distribute the complete product line of Matheson NANOCHEM gas purification products throughout Europe.
The worldwide market potential for gas purification products is estimated to be $30 million per year, Pall said.
